sources.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.title: Urgent Maternal Warning Signs poster
sources.jurisdiction: United States; government public-health warning information
sources.notes: Candidate-only CDC material; official acquisition 2026-10-14. Not an approved guideline or runtime warning claim. Pregnancy means explicitly current pregnancy here; possible pregnancy alone is insufficient. Detailed dizziness qualification: ongoing or recurring over many days, without inventing a numeric cutoff. Fainting is separately qualified by current pregnancy/current symptoms. Poster emergency access is conditional on inability to reach a provider. Dates: No publication date printed; PDF creation 2023-09-28 is not a clinical review date.
